text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was finally time for Eishin Flash's Make Debut, but as for her—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Post time is in 30 minutes.
Let's finish up our final checks.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: There's no reason for me to be nervous, after all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
For today's sake, Trainer-san and I
have trained again and again.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"If that's the case, then all that's left is to do what must be done.
Wouldn't you agree?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "That's true, but many girls still let their emotions get in the way and can't stay calm."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...It's nothing special.
I'm just doing what comes naturally."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—25 minutes to post.
Well then, I shall be on my way.
